review_notes: All 40 assigned records were checked against the current clock registry, their evidence-ledger entries, and complete methods-audit entries. Candidate values match the reviewed ledger values; all assigned methods-audit entries report no unresolved fields.

All 40 citation DOI values map to the assigned clock name in the date-stamped citation audit. The audit title, citation count, and 2026-10-02 observation date match each candidate record. Same-paper model variants share that publication count; preprint and journal counts were not added together.

Live primary-source checks covered the published Pasta article (including human and mouse model descriptions), the PCBrainAge article, and the stemTOC article. Existing primary-source audit records were used for remaining fields. PAOPAC limitations are retained as unresolved; no live full-text review of its preprint is claimed.

Training details quote only source-backed cohort, sample, age, or health facts in the evidence ledger. Broad or unspecified cohorts are left broad. No scores were recalculated and no shared registry, model, or notebook files were edited.
